svg.title: Five migration mechanisms feed one business cutover decision
svg.desc: Five separate migration jobs supply evidence: files must reach a readable target, a supported server rehost must run, database rows and changes need a final write boundary, network and DNS must carry customer traffic, and staff identity must permit and deny the right access. The business cutover gate requires tested journeys, reconciled data, one writer, a return plan and owner acceptance. Price replication, overlap, validation, endpoints, retained copies and cleanup. This is conceptual, not deployed AWS infrastructure.
svg.text: One move may need five different jobs
Test each path before one business cutover decision.
Final changes reach a readable target
Cutover gate: journeys + reconciled data + one writer
Return plan + owner acceptance; missing path means hold.
Price replication, overlap, validation, endpoints, retained copies, cleanup.
Conceptual paths; no AWS migration deployed.
